school: 外科学与临床医学（以外科手术、麻醉与运动预防把医学推向'动手'一极的先驱，'外科圣手'）
historical_significance: 华佗（约145-208），东汉末沛国谯（今安徽亳州）人，与董奉、张仲景并称'建安三神医'。拒举孝廉、辞太尉辟，周游民间行医。其独特处在于把中国医学推向'动手'一极：以麻沸散行全身麻醉下的剖腹手术——'醉无所觉，因刳破腹背，抽割积聚，既而缝合，敷以神膏'，是世界医学史上最早的全身麻醉外科完整方案；创五禽戏把运动写成日常保健处方（'人体欲得劳动，但不当使极尔'）；诊断上以望形断病、脉理辨胎；治疗上同症异治（倪寻李延案）、单方精刺（夹脊穴即针即效）、以情胜情（怒疗郁证）、虫积溯源（生鱼致病说）。因拒绝曹操征召下狱，临死欲以书传医术而狱吏不受，'索火烧之'——麻沸散与外科术随之失传，成为中国科学史上最著名的传承失败案例。五禽戏经弟子吴普传世，'华佗夹脊'沿用至今。
historical_significance_en: Hua Tuo (c. 145-208), born in Qiao county of Pei state (modern Bozhou, Anhui) at the end of the Eastern Han, one of the 'Three Divine Physicians of Jian'an' alongside Dong Feng and Zhang Zhongjing. Refusing recommendations to office and invitations from the Grand Commandant, he practiced among the people on the road. His distinctiveness was pushing Chinese medicine toward the interventional pole: laparotomy under general anesthesia with mafeisan — 'intoxicated and unaware, he opened the abdomen and back, cut away the mass, sutured and dressed with the divine salve' — the earliest complete general-anesthesia surgical protocol in world medical history. His five-animal exercise wrote movement as a daily health prescription ('the body needs exertion, only not to excess'); in diagnosis he read the face for inner disease and distinguished twin fetuses by pulse; in treatment he gave opposite remedies for identical symptoms (the Ni Xun-Li Yan case), struck single acupoints (his paraspinal points still taught worldwide), cured rage-stagnation by directed anger, and traced parasites to raw fish. Imprisoned for refusing Cao Cao's summons, he offered his medical writings to his jailer, who dared not take them; 'he asked for fire and burned it' — mafeisan and the surgery were lost, the most famous transmission failure in Chinese scientific history. The five-animal exercise survived through his disciple Wu Pu, and his paraspinal points remain in use today.
unique_thinking: 华佗思维模式的独特性在于'动手一极'的完整方法论：他不著书立说而以操作立医，把医学从'开方—服药'扩展为'诊断—麻醉—操作—术后'的完整工程链。五点尤具原创性——(1)以麻沸散解决外科的真正瓶颈（疼痛与挣扎），使'刳割'从不可能变为流程：使能技术先于主操作，比西方乙醚麻醉早一千六百余年；(2)五禽戏把'运动'从零散导引升级为成套、可传习、带剂量上限（'不当使极'）的正式处方，并以施行者的身体（吴普九十余岁耳目聪明）作为疗效证据；(3)同症异治的现场示范（外实下之、内实汗之）把个体化决策从原则变为可复现的临床行为；(4)以情胜情：把情绪当作有剂量、有时机的处方元素，心身同治；(5)虫积溯源直达饮食结构（生鱼致病、戒生食），病因具体化先于疗效精确化。同时他以死示范了知识管理的反面教材：'索火烧之'——传承机制缺失时，个体的死亡即体系的死亡。
unique_thinking_en: The uniqueness of Hua Tuo's thinking is a complete methodology of the interventional pole: he founded medicine on operations rather than books, extending it from 'prescribe and dose' to the full engineering chain of diagnosis, anesthesia, procedure and aftercare. Five points are especially original: (1) mafeisan solved surgery's true bottleneck — pain and struggle — turning resection from the impossible into a process: the enabling technology preceding the main operation, over sixteen centuries before ether in the West; (2) the five-animal exercise upgraded scattered daoyin into a set, teachable prescription with its own dose cap ('only not to excess'), with the practitioner's own body (Wu Pu, keen-eared at ninety) as the evidence of efficacy; (3) same-symptom-different-treatment demonstrated live (purge the external excess, sweat the internal) made individualized decision a reproducible clinical act, not a principle; (4) one emotion overcoming another: emotion as a prescribable element with dose and timing, mind and body treated together; (5) tracing parasites to the diet itself (raw fish causes, raw fish forbidden) — concretizing the etiology before refining the cure. And in his death he furnished the negative textbook of knowledge management: 'he asked for fire and burned it' — where the transmission mechanism is missing, the death of the individual is the death of the system.
civilization_zh: 东汉末年乱世：生于沛国谯县（今安徽亳州），活动于淮河流域的沛、广陵、彭城、盐渎一带；东汉政治崩坏、疫病频仍，儒学正统之外民间医术活跃；曹操挟天子而令诸侯，头风发作，召佗为侍医；佗以妻病辞归，曹操按验属实后收狱拷问，荀彧求情谓'佗术实工，人命所县'；建安十三年（208）佗死于狱中，曹冲病重时操叹'吾悔杀华佗，令此儿强死也'
civilization_en: The chaos at the end of the Eastern Han: born in Qiao county of Pei state (modern Bozhou, Anhui), active along the Huai River basin in Pei, Guangling, Pengcheng and Yandu; amid political collapse and frequent epidemics, medical practice flourished outside the Confucian orthodoxy; Cao Cao, controlling the emperor, suffered chronic headaches and summoned Tuo as personal physician; Tuo pleaded his wife's illness to return, was detained and interrogated after Cao Cao verified the excuse, with Xun Yu pleading that 'Tuo's art is truly masterly and human lives hang on it'; he died in prison in 208; when Cao Chong fell gravely ill, Cao lamented 'I regret killing Hua Tuo and letting this son die in vain.'
key_works: 华佗夹脊穴法（经针灸典籍传世）
漆叶青黏散（经樊阿传世）

cross_references.description_zh: 华佗与张仲景同为建安神医而路径相反：仲景以《伤寒杂病论》的条文-方剂体系把医学写成'可读的文本'，华佗以手术-麻醉-导引的操作体系把医学做成'可施的动作'——一个以书传世而体系永存，一个以技行世而书焚于狱：同代两条路线的命运对照，恰构成知识传承方式（文档 vs 身传）的最完整实验。
cross_references.description_en: Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing, divine physicians of the same Jian'an era, took opposite roads: Zhongjing wrote medicine as readable text — the pattern-formula system of the Shanghan Zabing Lun — while Hua Tuo made medicine as performable action — surgery, anesthesia and exercise; one transmitted by book with the system surviving forever, one practiced by hand with the book burned in prison: a same-era natural experiment on transmission by document versus transmission by body.

cross_references.description_zh: 华佗是孙思邈方法的四个上游之一：孙思邈'针药并用'的提法明确把'只用一种手段者非良医'与华佗方药针灸手术多栖的实践相接续；'摄养有常法'的运动常数承接五禽戏把运动写成日常处方的先例；孙思邈在《千金要方》中收录'华佗霍乱吐方'等佗方——华佗失传的体系经由孙思邈的档案法获得部分存续，恰是'文档化传承'对'身传失败'的历史补救。
cross_references.description_en: Hua Tuo is one of Sun Simiao's four upstreams: Sun's multimodal doctrine that 'the single-modality practitioner is no good physician' continues Hua Tuo's mastery of herbs, needles and surgery; Sun's constant self-regulation inherits the five-animal precedent of exercise as daily prescription; and the Qianjin Yaofang preserves formulas attributed to Tuo — the lost system partially rescued by Sun's archive method, the historical remedy of documentation for the failure of body-transmission.

cross_references.description_zh: 华佗与盖伦是古代外科的两大高峰而制度命运相反：盖伦得到罗马帝国与角斗士伤员的体系支撑，解剖-治疗传统靠权威文本传续千年；华佗在'身体发肤受之父母'的文化约束与权力征召之间独木支撑，书焚技失——外科的兴衰不只取决于技术高度，更取决于制度与传承环境：两者的对照是技术史对'环境决定论'的天然案例。
cross_references.description_en: Hua Tuo and Galen, twin peaks of ancient surgery with opposite institutional fates: Galen had the Roman empire and gladiators' wounds behind him, his anatomical-therapeutic tradition carried a millennium by authoritative texts; Hua Tuo stood alone between the cultural constraint of 'body and hair from one's parents' and the summons of power, his book burned and art lost — surgery's rise and fall depends not on technical height alone but on institutional and transmission environment: a natural case for environmental determinism in the history of technology.

cross_references.description_zh: 李时珍对华佗是档案法对失传知识的二次拯救：《本草纲目》系统收录散见于后世方书的华佗佗方与麻沸散组成线索（曼陀罗花等），并在虫部、草部多处引'佗曰'——失传内容经由晚出档案的可考残片被部分重建；华佗案也反向印证李时珍'每一药必注出处'的档案纪律：文档化不是著述偏好，而是知识存活的唯一保险。
cross_references.description_en: Li Shizhen stands to Hua Tuo as the archive rescuing lost knowledge a second time: the Bencao Gangmu systematically collects Hua Tuo's scattered formulas and the compositional clues of mafeisan (datura flower among them), citing 'Tuo said' throughout the insect and herb sections — the lost content partially rebuilt from verifiable fragments in later archives; the Hua Tuo case in turn vindicates Li's archival discipline of sourcing every drug: documentation is not a stylistic preference but the only insurance of knowledge's survival.

modes.name_en: The Method of Decisive Surgical Repair
modes.domain_zh: 把外科手术从'死马当活马医'的最后赌博重构为有诊断依据、有案例筛选、有操作规程的正式治疗选项——当药石无效而病灶局部可切除时，果断动手是最负责任的选择而非最鲁莽的选择
modes.domain_en: Rebuilding surgery from a last-resort gamble into a formal treatment option with diagnostic grounds, case selection and operating discipline — when drugs fail and the lesion is locally resectable, decisive action is the responsible choice, not the reckless one
modes.definition_zh: 把外科手术从'死马当活马医'的最后赌博重构为有诊断依据、有案例筛选、有操作规程的正式治疗选项——当药石无效而病灶局部可切除时，果断动手是最负责任的选择而非最鲁莽的选择
modes.definition_en: Rebuilding surgery from a last-resort gamble into a formal treatment option with diagnostic grounds, case selection and operating discipline — when drugs fail and the lesion is locally resectable, decisive action is the responsible choice, not the reckless one
modes.source_chapter: 《三国志·华佗传》《后汉书·华佗传》所载疗创、剖腹诸案
modes.key_quote_zh: 若病结积在内，针药所不能及，当须刳割者，便饮其麻沸散，须臾便如醉死无所知，因破取
modes.key_quote_en: 'If the disease gathers within, beyond the reach of needle or drug, and cutting is required — give him the mafeisan, and in a moment he lies as one dead, knowing nothing; then open and take it out.'
process_zh: 先穷尽保守手段：针药并施、观察病势——只有'针药所不能及'才进入手术议程，手术是排除法的结论而非第一冲动
确证病灶局部化：判断病结'在内'且可定位、可切除——手术的适用前提是病灶边界清晰，而非一切重病皆可开刀
术前准备药理支持：麻沸散醉之使'无所知'——把疼痛与恐惧从手术方程中扣除，病人安全优先于术者方便
按规程执行并交付术后方案：'既而缝合，敷以神膏，四五日创意，一月之间皆平复'——手术止于缝合，治愈终于随访
process_en: Exhaust conservative means first: needles and drugs together, watching the disease's course — only what 'needle and drug cannot reach' enters the surgical agenda; surgery is the conclusion of an exclusion process, not a first impulse
Confirm localization: judge that the mass lies within yet is findable and resectable — the precondition is a clear lesion boundary, not that every grave illness merits the knife
Pharmacological support before cutting: the mafeisan intoxicates so the patient 'knows nothing' — subtracting pain and fear from the surgical equation, patient safety above operator convenience

Execute by protocol and hand over aftercare: 'then suture, dress with the divine salve; in four or five days the wound closes, in a month all is level again' — the operation ends at the suture, the cure ends at follow-up
representative_cases_zh: 对'病在腹中、针药不及'者行剖腹切除并缝合敷膏：《三国志》所载最完整的手术流程记录——诊断、麻醉、操作、术后四位一体
广陵太守陈登胸中烦懑案：诊为'胃中有虫数升'，以汤药驱出——先判病灶性质，能药则药，不轻易动刀
曹操头风案：佗以针术随手而差，但明言'此病根在脑中，短期可缓不可除'——手术台边的诚实：能治什么、不能治什么，先说清楚
representative_cases_en: The abdominal resection with suture and salve recorded in the Sanguozhi: the most complete early operative protocol — diagnosis, anesthesia, procedure and aftercare in one chain

Chen Deng's thoracic oppression case: diagnosed as 'several sheng of parasites in the stomach', expelled by decoction — judge the lesion's nature first; when medicine suffices, do not reach for the knife

Cao Cao's headache: Hua Tuo relieved it with a needle at a touch, yet stated plainly 'the root lies within the brain; it can be eased, not removed short-term' — honesty at the bedside: say first what can and cannot be cured
modern_applications_zh: 外科手术准入与案例筛选制度：手术指征（indication）管理——不是'能做就做'而是'该做才做'
围手术期管理 bundles：术前评估、麻醉准备、术后随访被整合为标准路径——加速康复外科（ERAS）的现代版
急诊创伤的'损伤控制外科'：先稳住生命体征、再决定是否手术——保守与手术之间的动态决策线
modern_applications_en: Surgical indication management: not 'can we operate' but 'should we' — case selection as a formal discipline
Perioperative care bundles: preoperative assessment, anesthesia readiness and postoperative follow-up integrated into a standard pathway — the modern heir of ERAS
Damage-control surgery in trauma: stabilize vitals first, decide on operation after — the dynamic line between conservatism and the knife
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
盖伦（跨文明平行：罗马世界的创伤外科权威，同以'敢动手+守规程'立业）
李斯特（传承：抗菌外科把术后感染从宿命变为可防——敷膏神效的化学化完成）
张仲景（对照：同代而路径相反——仲景以方药体系立医，佗以操作体系立医，外科与内科的分野自此始）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Five-Animal Exercise Regimen
modes.domain_zh: 把运动写成日常保健的正式处方：模仿虎鹿熊猿鸟五种动物的典型动作编成操练体系，'导引'使气血流通、'流水不腐户枢不蠹'——身体如器械，常动则不坏
modes.domain_en: Writing exercise as a formal daily prescription: imitating the tiger, deer, bear, ape and bird in a drill system that moves qi and blood — 'running water does not rot, nor the door-hinge worm'; the body is an apparatus that stays sound only in motion
modes.definition_zh: 把运动写成日常保健的正式处方：模仿虎鹿熊猿鸟五种动物的典型动作编成操练体系，'导引'使气血流通、'流水不腐户枢不蠹'——身体如器械，常动则不坏
modes.definition_en: Writing exercise as a formal daily prescription: imitating the tiger, deer, bear, ape and bird in a drill system that moves qi and blood — 'running water does not rot, nor the door-hinge worm'; the body is an apparatus that stays sound only in motion
modes.source_chapter: 《后汉书·华佗传》引佗语；五禽戏传承谱系
modes.key_quote_zh: 人体欲得劳动，但不当使极尔。动摇则谷气得消，血脉流通，病不得生，譬犹户枢不朽是也
modes.key_quote_en: 'The body needs exertion — only not to excess. Movement digests the grain and circulates the blood, and illness cannot arise; like the door-hinge that never decays.'
process_zh: 建立'动'的公理：先立'人体欲得劳动'的健康模型——把身体理解为用进废退的器械，运动是维护不是消耗
限定动的上界：'不当使极'——运动处方同时写着剂量上限，过度即伤
把处方编成可传习的动作包：虎鹿熊猿鸟五式各取其神——动作要成体系、可教学、可天天做，而非零散招式
以身示范验证疗效：弟子吴普行之，'年九十余，耳目聪明，齿牙完坚'——处方有效性的证据是施行者自己的身体
process_en: Lay down the axiom of motion: 'the body needs exertion' — the body understood as an apparatus that thrives on use; exercise is maintenance, not expenditure
Cap the dose: 'only not to excess' — the prescription carries its own upper limit; overtraining injures
Package the prescription as a teachable set: five forms drawing the spirit of tiger, deer, bear, ape and bird — a system one can learn, teach and practice daily, not scattered tricks
Prove it on one's own body: disciple Wu Pu practiced it and 'at ninety-some his ears and eyes were keen, his teeth firm' — the evidence for the prescription is the practitioner's own person
representative_cases_zh: 五禽戏五式成套传世：虎之威、鹿之安、熊之稳、猿之灵、鸟之轻——每式各有主练的躯体部位与气血走向，是中国最早的成套健身操
吴普施之'年九十余耳目聪明'：史上第一个有据可查的运动处方长期随访结局
佗对弟子言'古之仙者为导引之事'而自创五禽新法：不泥古法——在既有导引传统上做原创重编，而非照抄古人
representative_cases_en: The five-animal set transmitted whole: the tiger's majesty, deer's repose, bear's steadiness, ape's agility, bird's lightness — each form targeting its own body regions and meridians, China's earliest systematic calisthenics
Wu Pu 'at ninety-some with keen ears and firm teeth': the first documented long-term follow-up outcome of an exercise prescription
Tuo citing the ancients' daoyin yet composing his own five animals: no servility to tradition — an original recomposition on the existing daoyin heritage
modern_applications_zh: 运动是良医（Exercise is Medicine）与体医融合：运动处方进入慢病管理一线——'五禽导引法'的临床化现代版
职业健康与工间操：久坐岗位的定时活动制度——'户枢不蠹'的组织化
康复医学的运动疗法：术后与慢病的分级运动处方，剂量与上限同开
modern_applications_en: Exercise is Medicine and the sports-medicine fusion: exercise prescriptions on the front line of chronic-disease care — the clinical modernization of the five animals
Occupational health and workplace micro-breaks: scheduled movement for sedentary roles — 'the door-hinge never worms' organized at scale
Therapeutic exercise in rehabilitation: graded exercise prescriptions for post-op and chronic disease, dose and cap issued together
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
希波克拉底（跨文明平行：'行走是最好的药'——运动医学的共同源头）
库珀（传承：有氧运动科学把'运动处方'量化为心率与剂量）
孙思邈（传承：摄养有常法把日常养护写成行为常数——与五禽戏同以习惯养身）

modes.name_en: The Method of Diagnosis by Visible Signs
modes.domain_zh: 以外部可见信号（面色、形态、脉象、二便）快速推断内部病灶：'病深而形外露'——体内的问题必然在体表留下可读的痕迹，诊断即读痕迹之学
modes.domain_en: Inferring internal lesions fast from externally visible signs — complexion, form, pulse, excreta: 'what is deep shows without'; whatever goes wrong inside leaves readable traces on the surface, and diagnosis is the art of reading them
modes.definition_zh: 以外部可见信号（面色、形态、脉象、二便）快速推断内部病灶：'病深而形外露'——体内的问题必然在体表留下可读的痕迹，诊断即读痕迹之学
modes.definition_en: Inferring internal lesions fast from externally visible signs — complexion, form, pulse, excreta: 'what is deep shows without'; whatever goes wrong inside leaves readable traces on the surface, and diagnosis is the art of reading them
modes.key_quote_zh: 君有急病见于面，莫多饮
modes.key_quote_en: 'You have an urgent illness showing in your face — do not drink too much.'
process_zh: 建立'内病必有外候'的映射表：面色、形态、声音、脉象各自对应哪些内部状态——把身体读成一本可检索的体征字典
多信号交叉验证：面、脉、形不孤证——单一体征可能是偶然，多通道指向一致才下判断
区分可逆与不可逆：读出'病深'者明言不可治，读出可逆者立即施治——诊断的第一输出是可治性分级，而非病名
即见即断、断后即行：'见于面'当场说出——诊断的时效价值高于完备性，危急症不给从容会诊的时间
process_en: Build the map of 'inner illness must show without': which complexions, forms, voices and pulses correspond to which internal states — the body as a searchable dictionary of signs
Cross-validate multiple signals: face, pulse and form never testify alone — a single sign may be chance; only converging channels license a judgment

Sort reversible from irreversible: where the reading says 'deep', say plainly it cannot be cured; where reversible, treat at once — diagnosis's first output is a treatability triage, not a disease name
See, judge, act on the spot: 'showing in your face', said then and there — diagnostic timeliness outranks completeness; the critical case allows no leisurely consultation
representative_cases_zh: 盐渎严昕与数人应召而至，佗望之即言'君有急病见于面'——众人尚自感无恙，数日内果如所言：纯粹望诊的极端案例
俱行轺车边一'食醋'病人（梅尼埃类）案：闻其呻吟、察其停车欲卧即断' suspend不治'——听觉与行为观察并用
府吏倪寻、李延俱头痛身热：佗断一为外实（下之）、一为内虚（汗之）——同症异因，靠追问病机细节而非症状表面完成分诊
representative_cases_en: Yan Xin of Yandu summoned with others: Hua Tuo, on sight alone, said 'you carry an urgent illness in your face' — the man felt fine; within days it came true: an extreme case of pure inspection
The vinegar-drinker by the roadside: from his groans and his halting to lie down, Tuo judged his case hopeless — hearing and behavioral observation together

Two officials, Ni Xun and Li Yan, both with headache and fever: one treated by purging (external excess), one by sweating (internal deficiency) — same symptoms, different causes, triaged by interrogating the mechanism beneath the presentation
modern_applications_zh: 临床快速识别（pattern recognition）与早期预警评分（NEWS）：护士巡房'看一眼就知道不行了'——望形断病的当代形态
分诊制度的等级设计：急诊预检把'见于面'的直觉固化为可计分的分诊协议
远程医疗的视诊边界：视频问诊重估'望诊'权重——体征信号被数字化后仍是第一道筛查
modern_applications_en: Clinical pattern recognition and early-warning scores (NEWS): the nurse who 'takes one look and knows' — visible-sign diagnosis in modern dress
Triage-level design: emergency pre-check codifies the face-reading intuition into scorable protocols
Telemedicine's inspection boundary: video consults re-weigh visual signs — digitized, they remain the first screen
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
扁鹊（源头：'望而知之谓之神'——望诊列为四诊之神的最早传统）
奥斯勒（跨文明平行：床旁观察医学——'听你的病人，他在告诉你诊断'）
张仲景（同代对照：仲景把诊法写成条文系统《伤寒论》平脉辨证，佗以现场快速判断见长——系统化与直觉化的两条诊断路线）

modes.name_en: The Method of Minimal Precise Intervention
modes.domain_zh: 用最少的干预点解决核心问题：一针、一方、一穴——找准关键杠杆点，以最小代价获得最大疗效，反对大水漫灌式的叠加用药
modes.domain_en: Solve the core problem with the fewest intervention points: one needle, one formula, one acupoint — find the key lever and gain maximal effect at minimal cost, against the flood-irrigation of stacked drugs
modes.definition_zh: 用最少的干预点解决核心问题：一针、一方、一穴——找准关键杠杆点，以最小代价获得最大疗效，反对大水漫灌式的叠加用药
modes.definition_en: Solve the core problem with the fewest intervention points: one needle, one formula, one acupoint — find the key lever and gain maximal effect at minimal cost, against the flood-irrigation of stacked drugs
modes.key_quote_zh: 佗曰：脉理如前，是两胎……并以为实，治则皆愈
modes.key_quote_en: 'The pulse reads as before: this is a twin pregnancy… treat both as real, and one cure settles all.'
process_zh: 把问题压缩为单一病机：诸症背后往往只有一个关键病机——先找到它，不与表层症状缠斗
选最小干预单元：能一针不两针、能单方不复方——干预数量本身是成本与风险
直取杠杆点：夹脊穴等'关键节点'的发现与使用——力作用在结构的关键处，小力大效
即时验证并收手：'应手而差'即止——有效就停，不追加保险性治疗；无效则快速改道而非加大剂量
process_en: Compress the problem to one mechanism: behind the many symptoms usually stands a single key pathology — find it; do not wrestle with surface presentations
Choose the smallest intervention unit: one needle over two, a single formula over a compound — the count of interventions is itself cost and risk
Strike the lever point: the discovery and use of the jiaji points beside the spine — force applied at a structural keystone, small effort, great effect
Verify at once and stop: 'the hand withdraws as the illness yields' — efficacy ends the episode, with no insurance-stacking; failure reroutes quickly instead of escalating dose
representative_cases_zh: 曹操头风发动的即时针法：'佗针鬲，随手而差'——单穴取效、随手即止，无后续用药
双重妊娠的诊断：脉象辨出'两胎'并断'治则皆愈'——把复杂病情还原为准确病机后，一个方案解决全部
夹脊穴的创用：脊柱旁0.5寸一排穴位，至今仍是国际通用的'华佗夹脊'——一个杠杆点发明服务两千年
representative_cases_en: The instant needling of Cao Cao's headache: 'Tuo needled the diaphragm point and it yielded at his hand' — one acupoint, stop at effect, no follow-on drugs
The twin-pregnancy diagnosis: the pulse separated 'two embryos' and one plan 'cured all' — reduce a complex case to its exact mechanism and a single scheme settles it
The invention of the paraspinal points, half an inch beside the spine, still taught worldwide as 'Hua Tuo's jiaji' — one lever-point invention serving two millennia
modern_applications_zh: 关键少数与杠杆点管理：20%的关键节点决定80%的结果——先找杠杆再用力
最小可行干预（MVI）与A/B测试：先上单变量改动验证因果，反对一次性堆叠十个功能
精准医疗与单靶点药物：从鸡尾酒轰炸转向关键靶点抑制——小分子抑制剂对单一致病通路的'一针'逻辑
modern_applications_en: The vital few and lever-point management: 20% of key nodes decide 80% of outcomes — find the lever before applying force
Minimal viable intervention and A/B testing: ship one variable change to establish causality; refuse stacking ten features at once
Precision medicine and single-target drugs: from cocktail bombardment to inhibiting the key target — the small-molecule inhibitor as the modern 'one needle'
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
扁鹊（源头：'随病所宜'一针一熨的极简干预传统）
帕累托（跨文明平行：关键少数法则——干预经济学的数学化表述）
张仲景（同代对照：仲景以严谨复方体系立'经方'之繁，佗以单方精刺立'简验'之约——繁简两条治疗路线互补）

modes.domain_zh: 为不可行的关键操作先创造可行性条件：麻沸散使剖腹成为可能——重大突破常常不在于操作本身，而在于先把'使操作成为可能'的前置技术造出来
modes.domain_en: Create the enabling condition before the infeasible key operation: mafeisan made laparotomy possible — the great breakthrough often lies not in the operation itself but in first building the prerequisite technology that makes the operation possible
modes.definition_zh: 为不可行的关键操作先创造可行性条件：麻沸散使剖腹成为可能——重大突破常常不在于操作本身，而在于先把'使操作成为可能'的前置技术造出来
modes.definition_en: Create the enabling condition before the infeasible key operation: mafeisan made laparotomy possible — the great breakthrough often lies not in the operation itself but in first building the prerequisite technology that makes the operation possible
modes.key_quote_zh: 醉无所觉，因刳破腹背，抽割积聚
modes.key_quote_en: 'Intoxicated and unaware, he opened the abdomen and back, and cut away the mass.'
process_zh: 识别不可行的真正瓶颈：剖腹术的瓶颈不是刀法而是疼痛与挣扎——先问'是什么让该做的事做不成'
为瓶颈设计专门解药：以多种草药复合成'麻沸散'专司意识与痛觉的暂时关闭——瓶颈问题配瓶颈技术
控制深度与时限：'须臾便如醉死无所知'——使能技术必须可定时、可恢复，麻醉的窗即手术的窗
使能与操作配套交付：醉→割→缝→膏一体化流程——前置技术只有嵌入完整流程才创造价值
process_en: Identify the true bottleneck of the infeasible: laparotomy's bottleneck was not knife-work but pain and struggle — ask first 'what makes the needed thing impossible?'
Design a dedicated countermeasure for the bottleneck: compound herbs into mafeisan to temporarily switch off consciousness and pain — a bottleneck problem gets a bottleneck technology
Control depth and duration: 'in a moment he lies as one dead, knowing nothing' — the enabling technology must be timed and reversible; the anesthesia window is the surgery window
Deliver enablement bundled with the operation: intoxicate, cut, suture, dress — one integrated flow; a prerequisite technology creates value only embedded in the complete process
representative_cases_zh: 麻沸散+剖腹术的完整流程记录：'醉无所觉，既而缝合，敷以神膏'——世界医学史上最早的全身麻醉手术完整方案
麻沸散由曼陀罗花等多味药配伍的复方面世（后世方书所载）：复合配伍以平衡效力与安全——单味药做不到的深度由配方达成
对'病结在内针药所不能及'者的开刀决策：正因为有了麻醉，手术适应症从'别无选择'扩展为'最优选择'——使能技术改变了适应症的定义
representative_cases_en: The full record of mafeisan plus laparotomy: 'intoxicated and unaware, then sutured and dressed with the divine salve' — the earliest complete general-anesthesia surgical protocol in world medical history
The compound recipe of datura and other herbs in later formularies: compounding to balance potency and safety — the depth a single herb cannot reach is achieved by the formula
Operating on those 'beyond needle and drug': with anesthesia in hand, surgical indication widened from 'no other choice' to 'the best choice' — an enabling technology redefines the indication itself
modern_applications_zh: 术前'麻醉评估'作为手术准入门槛：麻醉学科独立成科——使能环节获得与主操作同等的资源与地位
复杂系统改造中的'前置使能投资'：先修路再通车、先建CI/CD再谈持续交付——使能步骤是项目关键路径而非辅助成本
无痛内镜与舒适化医疗：把'病人耐受'从手术成功的约束条件中移除——舒适化改造扩大了可开展的诊疗范围
modern_applications_en: Pre-anesthesia assessment as the gate of surgery: anesthesiology as an independent specialty — the enabling step wins resources and standing equal to the main operation
Enabling-investment-first in complex system transformation: build the road before running cars, CI/CD before continuous delivery — enablement sits on the critical path, not the support budget
Painless endoscopy and comfort-based care: removing 'patient tolerance' from the success constraints — comfort engineering widens the range of feasible procedures
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
莫顿（跨文明平行：1846年乙醚麻醉公开演示——使能外科的同一逻辑，晚一千七百年）
扁鹊（源头：'毒酒'迷之而剖的传统使佗的复合麻醉有据可循）
李斯特（对照：李斯特使'术后感染'可防，华佗使'术中疼痛'可控——两大使能共同把外科从赌博变为工程）

modes.domain_zh: 同一症状、不同病机、不同处方：华佗对同患头痛身热的两位府吏开出'下之'与'汗之'相反治法——处方的变量是'这个人此刻的病机'，不是症状标签
modes.domain_en: Same symptom, different mechanism, different prescription: to two officials with identical headache and fever, Hua Tuo gave opposite treatments, purge and sweat — the prescription's variable is this person's mechanism now, not the symptom label
modes.definition_zh: 同一症状、不同病机、不同处方：华佗对同患头痛身热的两位府吏开出'下之'与'汗之'相反治法——处方的变量是'这个人此刻的病机'，不是症状标签
modes.definition_en: Same symptom, different mechanism, different prescription: to two officials with identical headache and fever, Hua Tuo gave opposite treatments, purge and sweat — the prescription's variable is this person's mechanism now, not the symptom label
modes.key_quote_zh: 寻外实，延内实，故治之宜殊
modes.key_quote_en: 'Xun's excess is external, Yan's internal — hence their treatments must differ.'
process_zh: 拒绝症状等价：症状相同只说明初筛相同——处方决策开始于症状层面之后的病机层面
追问病机差异：外感还是内伤、实还是虚、何脏何经——把'看起来一样'拆解为'机制上哪里不一样'
允许处方相反：同症可下可汗、可温可清——两个相反方案可以都对，只要病机相反
以疗效回验病机：'并药即愈'——个体化判断的裁判是各自见效，而不是方案一致性
process_en: Refuse symptom-equivalence: equal symptoms only mean equal screening — the prescribing decision begins below the symptom layer, at the mechanism
Interrogate the difference of mechanism: exterior or interior, excess or deficiency, which organ and channel — decompose 'looks the same' into 'differs how, mechanically'
Permit opposite prescriptions: the same presentation may call for purging or sweating, warming or clearing — two opposite plans can both be right when the mechanisms oppose
Validate mechanism by outcome: 'each took his medicine and both recovered' — the judge of individualized judgment is each recovery, not plan uniformity
representative_cases_zh: 倪寻、李延同头痛身热而治法相反案：《三国志》原文完整记录'寻外实延内实故治之宜殊'并'并药即愈'——同病异治的最清晰史证
对孕妇双胎的'并以为实，治则皆愈'：同一母体的两个胎块各有其'实'——个体化精确到宫内个体
广陵陈登案中'吐出虫三升'后的后续医嘱：'三后期复发，遇良医可救'——个体化处方附带个体化的预后与随访路径
representative_cases_en: Ni Xun and Li Yan: identical headache and fever, opposite treatments — the Sanguozhi preserves the full text 'Xun external excess, Yan internal excess; hence differ', and 'both recovered': the clearest historical proof of same-disease-different-treatment
The twin pregnancy: 'treat both as real and all is cured' — individualization precise to each fetus within one mother

Follow-up advice after Chen Deng vomited 'three sheng of parasites': 'it will return in three years; with a good physician it can be saved' — an individualized prescription issued with its own prognosis and revisit path
modern_applications_zh: 精准医疗与生物标志物分层：同一癌症按突变谱开不同靶向药——'外实内实'的分子生物学重述
抗感染治疗的药敏指导用药：同一'肺炎'按病原学与耐药谱给不同抗生素
A/B测试中的分群分析：同一功能对'重度用户'与'轻度用户'设计相反的交互——个体化的工程版
modern_applications_en: Precision medicine and biomarker stratification: the same cancer, different targeted drugs by mutation profile — 'external vs internal excess' restated molecularly
Antimicrobial stewardship: the same 'pneumonia', different antibiotics by pathogen and resistance profile
Cohort analysis in A/B testing: the same feature designed with opposite interactions for heavy vs light users — individualization as engineering
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
张仲景（同代对照：仲景把同病异治写成条文体系'观其脉证随证治之'，佗以现场即断示范——同一原则的系统化与直觉化）
盖顿（跨文明平行：生理稳态的个体基线——'正常值'必须个体化解读）
孙思邈（传承：辨证应变法把个体化扩展为完整临床决策框架）

modes.domain_zh: 把情绪当作可致病的独立病因、也可治病的独立药源：怒可疗郁、喜可疗怒——对明确由情志郁结引发的躯体病，用定向的情绪冲击作处方
modes.domain_en: Treat emotion as an independent cause of disease and an independent source of cure: anger heals stagnation, joy counters anger — for somatic illness clearly caused by emotional blockage, prescribe a directed emotional impact
modes.definition_zh: 把情绪当作可致病的独立病因、也可治病的独立药源：怒可疗郁、喜可疗怒——对明确由情志郁结引发的躯体病，用定向的情绪冲击作处方
modes.definition_en: Treat emotion as an independent cause of disease and an independent source of cure: anger heals stagnation, joy counters anger — for somatic illness clearly caused by emotional blockage, prescribe a directed emotional impact
modes.source_chapter: 《三国志》注引《华佗别传》怒疗案
process_zh: 先做心身归因：躯体征候排查之后，判断其病因是否为情志郁结——情绪诊断是排除躯体器质因之后的正向判断，不是'查不出就说心理'
选定靶情绪：按五行相胜之理（怒胜思、喜胜悲等）确定用哪种情绪克哪种郁结——情绪选择有理论依据而非随机宣泄
设计情绪剂量与时机：以'多留其财''故意不药'等手法定向激怒——情绪冲击须足量、准时、可撤除
以躯体反应验收：'大怒则病除'、吐出黑血而愈——心理处方的疗效指标也是躯体体征，心身双轨验收
process_en: First attribute psychosomatically: after somatic work-up, judge whether the cause is emotional blockage — an emotion diagnosis is a positive judgment after excluding organic causes, not 'psychological because we found nothing'

Select the target emotion: by the five-phase overcoming law (anger overcomes brooding, joy counters sorrow), determine which emotion conquers which stagnation — the choice has a theory, not random catharsis
Design the dose and timing of emotion: withholding payment or medicine on purpose to provoke — the impact must be sufficient, punctual and removable

Verify by somatic response: 'with the rage the illness left', black blood vomited and health restored — the outcome metric of a psychological prescription is also somatic sign; mind and body accepted in dual tracks
representative_cases_zh: 郡守积怒呕血案：佗故意多受其财而不治、留书辱之——郡守大怒吐黑血数升而愈：史上最完整的'设计情绪剂量'记录
（附记）恨之入骨的曹操杀佗之后自叹'佗能活此'：情志疗法的边界警示——医者可以处方情绪，但不可得罪权力：本案同时是伦理与安全的教训
母子相思案（县尹之子）：佗以'喜'疗郁——用迎合其心之事使郁结自解，与怒疗同为'以情胜情'的两极
representative_cases_en: The prefect stewing in silent rage: Tuo took his money generously and left without treating, then sent a letter insulting him — the prefect's great rage vomited several sheng of black blood and he recovered: the most complete historical record of a designed emotional dose

(Margin note) Cao Cao, who killed Tuo in hatred, later sighed 'Tuo could have saved him': a boundary warning for emotion therapy — the physician may prescribe emotion but must not gamble with power; this case is at once an ethics and a safety lesson
The lovesick magistrate's son: Tuo cured with 'joy' — engaging what his heart craved so the blockage dissolved of itself; joy and rage as the two poles of 'one emotion overcoming another'
modern_applications_zh: 心身医学与心理生理疾病诊疗：功能性躯体症状（functional somatic syndrome）的病因识别与心理干预——情绪归因的临床化
行为激活与暴露疗法：定向设计情绪体验以解除焦虑/抑郁回路——'以情胜情'的循证化
用户体验与危机沟通：定向的情绪设计（紧张释放、惊喜反转）解决'情绪卡点'——情绪冲击的产品化
modern_applications_en: Psychosomatic medicine: identifying emotional etiology in functional somatic syndromes and intervening psychologically — emotion attribution made clinical
Behavioral activation and exposure therapy: designing directed emotional experiences to unlock anxiety and depression circuits — 'one emotion overcoming another' made evidence-based
UX and crisis communication: directed emotional design (tension release, surprise reversal) to clear 'emotional sticking points' — emotional impact as product
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
张子和（传承：金元四大家的攻邪派把情志疗法系统化为'九气'理论并大量施用）
弗洛伊德（跨文明平行：宣泄（catharsis）理论——情绪须被定向释放而非压抑）
笛卡尔（对照：心身二元论的缺陷反衬华佗'心身一体'的先见——情绪直接改写躯体状态）

modes.domain_zh: 从症状追到具体病原体：吐蛇、虫瘕、寄生虫积——不是'脾胃虚弱'之类的笼统病机，而是找到具体的致病物并对它下药；病因具体化是疗效精确化的前提
modes.domain_en: Trace the symptom to the concrete pathogen: vomited serpents, worm masses, parasite accumulation — not the vague mechanism of 'weak spleen and stomach' but the specific disease-causing agent, and drug aimed at it; concretizing the etiology is the precondition of precise efficacy
modes.definition_zh: 从症状追到具体病原体：吐蛇、虫瘕、寄生虫积——不是'脾胃虚弱'之类的笼统病机，而是找到具体的致病物并对它下药；病因具体化是疗效精确化的前提
modes.definition_en: Trace the symptom to the concrete pathogen: vomited serpents, worm masses, parasite accumulation — not the vague mechanism of 'weak spleen and stomach' but the specific disease-causing agent, and drug aimed at it; concretizing the etiology is the precondition of precise efficacy
modes.key_quote_zh: 吐出虫……以三轮生虫膏立已
modes.key_quote_en: 'The worms came out… the triple-round worm salve settled it at once.'
process_zh: 拒绝笼统病机：'体虚''胃弱'不能解释一切——凡可查者必须查到具体的致病实体
以排泄物为证据：吐出物、大便中查虫——诊断证据取自最直接的物证而非推理推测
对症下药于病原体本身：驱虫药、虫膏直指虫体——药物靶点是病原而非泛泛的'调理'
追溯感染来源并给防复发建议：病从'食生鱼脍'来的要忌口——治疗延伸到生活方式层面的传染源切断
process_en: Refuse vague mechanisms: 'deficiency' and 'weak stomach' cannot explain everything — whatever can be traced must be traced to a concrete pathogenic entity
Take excreta as evidence: examine the vomit and stool for worms — diagnostic evidence from the most direct specimen, not inference alone
Drug the pathogen itself: anthelmintics and worm salves aimed at the worm body — the drug target is the pathogen, not a general 'regulating'
Trace the infection source and advise relapse prevention: raw fish sliced dishes require abstinence — treatment extends to cutting the transmission source in daily life
representative_cases_zh: 广陵太守陈登'胸中烦懑面赤不食'案：佗脉之曰'胃中有虫数升，将成疽，腥物所为'，以汤药吐出虫三升——病名、病因（生食）、虫量三位一体的完整诊断
吐蛇案（彭城夫人夜之厕）：蛲虫或其他寄生虫自口出，佗断为虫证并给药——从惊恐症状还原为可治的虫病
'食鱼脍成瘕'案：劝其以蒜齑驱之并戒生食——病因追溯直达饮食结构，防复发与治病同开
representative_cases_en: Chen Deng, Governor of Guangling, 'oppression in the chest, flushed face, no appetite': Tuo felt the pulse and said 'several sheng of worms in the stomach, about to become an abscess, caused by raw fish', and a decoction brought up three sheng of worms — disease name, cause (raw food) and worm quantity in one complete diagnosis
The vomited-serpent case: a parasitic worm emerging from the mouth in terror at night; Tuo judged it a worm disorder and dosed accordingly — reducing a frightening symptom to a treatable disease
The 'raw-fish mass' case: garlic paste prescribed to expel it and raw fish forbidden — etiological tracing reaching all the way to dietary structure, relapse prevention and cure issued together
modern_applications_zh: 感染性疾病的病原学诊断：血培养、核酸检测先把'发热待查'变为'明确病原'再用药——病原具体化的实验室化
食品安全溯源：从病例倒查食品供应链（HACCP体系）——'腥物所为'的现代公共卫生版
靶向治疗与病原体特异性药物：抗病毒、抗寄生虫药都要求先确证病原再给药——靶向前提是溯源
modern_applications_en: Pathogen-directed diagnosis in infectious disease: blood culture and nucleic-acid testing turn 'fever of unknown origin' into a named pathogen before treatment — etiological concretion lab-ified
Food-safety traceability: tracing the supply chain backward from cases (HACCP) — 'caused by raw fish' as modern public health
Targeted therapy and pathogen-specific drugs: antivirals and antiparasitics all require confirmed pathogen before dosing — targeting presumes tracing
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
巴斯德（跨文明平行：病原菌理论把'病因具体化'推到微生物层面——同一方法论的实验室完成）
詹姆斯·林德（对照：从坏血病案例倒推柑橘病因——溯源与干预的同一闭环）
孙思邈（传承：食治与病从口入的饮食干预传统——把病因管理延伸到餐桌）

modes.domain_zh: 拒绝以医术换官位：曹操屡召，佗'恃能厌事'终以妻病辞归——把行医自由置于仕途之上，专业价值由疗效而非头衔定义；技术的独立性与职业的自主性是行医伦理的地基
modes.domain_en: Refuse to trade the craft for office: repeatedly summoned by Cao Cao, Tuo pleaded his wife's illness to return home — placing freedom to practice above career; professional value is defined by efficacy, not title; the independence of skill and the autonomy of the vocation are the foundation of medical ethics
modes.definition_zh: 拒绝以医术换官位：曹操屡召，佗'恃能厌事'终以妻病辞归——把行医自由置于仕途之上，专业价值由疗效而非头衔定义；技术的独立性与职业的自主性是行医伦理的地基
modes.definition_en: Refuse to trade the craft for office: repeatedly summoned by Cao Cao, Tuo pleaded his wife's illness to return home — placing freedom to practice above career; professional value is defined by efficacy, not title; the independence of skill and the autonomy of the vocation are the foundation of medical ethics
modes.source_chapter: 《三国志·华佗传》《后汉书·华佗传》
modes.key_quote_zh: 然本作士人，以医见业，意常自悔
modes.key_quote_en: 'Though bred a scholar, he made his living by medicine, and often inwardly regretted it.'
process_zh: 确立价值坐标：先认定'治愈病人才是我的事业'——把职业价值锚定在服务对象与疗效上，而非权力体系的职位上
守住选择权：可应召出诊、但不接受编制化占有——'恃能厌事'：技能持有者保留对服务方式的裁量
用疗效而非头街背书：'人所不能治者，佗治之即效'——专业尊严的唯一来源是解决别人解决不了的问题
为自主付出代价并认账：终因拒召下狱而死——独立有价，选择自主就要承受其代价，不作道德表演
process_en: Fix the value coordinate: first decide that 'curing the patient is my vocation' — anchor professional worth in the served and the efficacy, not in a post within the power system
Keep the right of choice: answer summons to treat, yet refuse institutional capture — 'relying on his skill, weary of service': the skill-holder retains discretion over how he serves
Let efficacy, not title, vouch for him: 'what others could not cure, Tuo cured at a stroke' — the sole source of professional dignity is solving what others cannot
Pay for autonomy and own the cost: imprisoned and killed at last for refusing summons — independence has a price; choose it and bear it, without moral theater
representative_cases_zh: 屡辞征召而周游行医：沛相陈珪举孝廉、太尉黄琬辟，皆不就；曹操召为侍医，仍以妻病求归——技术人的择业自由 vs 权力的占有欲
在民间与权贵之间往返出诊：广陵、盐渎、彭城、东阳一带留下大量案迹——服务半径由病人需要决定，不由权力中心决定
曹操'佗恃能厌事'的判断与佗的沉默：权力视拒绝为傲慢，专业视拒绝为边界——两种职业观的结构性冲突
representative_cases_en: Refusing every summons while roaming to practice: recommended as Filial-and-Incorrupt by the Chancellor of Pei, invited by the Grand Commandant — he declined both; summoned as personal physician by Cao Cao, he pleaded his wife's illness to go home — the skilled person's freedom of vocation against power's appetite for possession
Consulting back and forth between commoners and grandees, leaving a trail of cases across Guangling, Yandu, Pengcheng and Dongyang — the service radius set by patients' need, not by the seat of power

Cao Cao's verdict 'he relies on his skill and wearies of service' and Tuo's silence: power reads refusal as arrogance, the profession reads it as boundary — the structural collision of two vocational philosophies
modern_applications_zh: 专业服务公司的合伙制与'专家不坐班'：顶尖专家保留选择项目与客户的权利——专业自主的组织化
开源社区与'技术信用'体系：开发者的声誉来自代码被采用而非职位——疗效背书的开源版
职业操守与'退出权'：律师、医师、工程师的职业道德都承认对不当要求说'不'的权利——自主是伦理的前提
modern_applications_en: Partnership models and 'experts off the bench': top specialists retain the right to choose projects and clients — professional autonomy organized
Open-source reputation systems: a developer's standing comes from adopted code, not position — efficacy-endorsement, open-sourced
Codes of ethics and the 'right of exit': law, medicine and engineering all recognize the right to refuse improper demands — autonomy as the precondition of ethics
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
庄子（源头：'曳尾于涂中'——拒绝权力占有、以自由为业的哲学先声）
希波克拉底（跨文明平行：科斯岛学派行医不隶于权门——职业自主的传统源头）
孙思邈（对照：同为医者，思邈屡辞而善终、佗拒召而身死——职业自主在不同权力环境下的两种结局）

modes.domain_zh: 华佗之死使麻沸散与外科术失传：知识若只存于一人之身、一手之技，其存亡系于一人之命——任何不可替代的关键能力都必须预设传承机制，否则个体的悲剧即体系的损失
modes.domain_en: Hua Tuo's death lost the mafeisan and his surgery: knowledge held in one person, one hand, lives and dies with one life — any irreplaceable key capability must presuppose a transmission mechanism, or the individual's tragedy becomes the system's loss
modes.definition_zh: 华佗之死使麻沸散与外科术失传：知识若只存于一人之身、一手之技，其存亡系于一人之命——任何不可替代的关键能力都必须预设传承机制，否则个体的悲剧即体系的损失
modes.definition_en: Hua Tuo's death lost the mafeisan and his surgery: knowledge held in one person, one hand, lives and dies with one life — any irreplaceable key capability must presuppose a transmission mechanism, or the individual's tragedy becomes the system's loss
modes.source_chapter: 《三国志·华佗传》：佗临死出一卷书与狱吏，吏畏法不受，佗亦不强，索火烧之
modes.key_quote_en: 'He asked for fire and burned it.'
process_zh: 承认知识的载体脆弱性：先承认'一手之技+一人之命'的存续结构天然脆弱——不预设传承的知识资产随时归零
识别关键知识并分级：哪些可以口头传承（五禽戏已被吴普带走），哪些必须文档化（麻沸散配方与手术流程）——按可传授性分级管理
设计多通道传承：弟子（吴普、樊阿）、文档（狱中书卷）、实物（针具药方）多路备份——单一通道即单点故障
警惕'情绪性销毁'：'索火烧之'——传承机制必须在情绪与权力压力到来之前建成，事到临头的一卷书救不回一个体系
process_en: Admit the fragility of the carrier: concede up front that 'one pair of hands plus one life' is a naturally perishable structure — knowledge assets without a transmission plan zero out at any moment
Classify key knowledge: what can pass orally (the five animals, already carried off by Wu Pu) versus what must be documented (the mafeisan recipe and operative flow) — manage by teachability tiers
Design multi-channel transmission: disciples (Wu Pu, Fan A), documents (the juan in prison), artifacts (needles, formulas) — parallel backups; a single channel is a single point of failure
Beware emotional destruction: 'he asked for fire and burned it' — the transmission mechanism must exist before pressure of emotion and power arrives; one juan at the end saves no system
representative_cases_zh: 临狱出书与索火焚书：唯一一份可能存续麻沸散与外科体系的文档，在'吏畏法不受'与佗'亦不强'之间烧毁——传承窗口的错过即永久损失
吴普传五禽戏、樊阿传漆叶青黏散：两名弟子各带走一部分而非全部——部分传承好过全无，但足以证明'分头带走'不如'完整归档'
后世复得'华佗夹脊'穴名而复得麻沸散配方遥遥无期：关键知识一旦失传，重建成本以百年计
representative_cases_en: The book offered from prison and burned by request: the one document that might have preserved mafeisan and the surgical system, destroyed between the jailer's fear and Tuo's own resignation — a missed transmission window is a permanent loss

Wu Pu carrying the five animals, Fan A the lacquer-and-haste powder: two disciples each took a part, none the whole — partial transmission beats none, yet proves 'taking pieces away' inferior to 'filing completely'
Later ages recovered the name 'Hua Tuo's paraspinal points' but never reliably the mafeisan recipe: once key knowledge is lost, the cost of rebuilding is counted in centuries
modern_applications_zh: 关键岗位继任计划（succession planning）与'巴士因子'（bus factor）管理：核心知识不押在任何单一人身上
文档化与'可交接'标准：代码、运维手册、客户关系必须达到'交接人可独立接手'的可读程度——文档不是可选美德而是系统部件
离职知识转移流程与组织记忆管理：关键人员离职前的强制知识转移期——'狱中一卷书'要在平时就写好
modern_applications_en: Key-position succession planning and bus-factor management: core knowledge never bet on one person

Documentation and the 'handover-ready' standard: code, runbooks, client relations written to a readability where a successor can take over independently — documentation as a system component, not an optional virtue
Off-boarding knowledge transfer and organizational memory: a mandatory transfer period before key personnel leave — the 'one juan in prison' written in ordinary days
representative_figures: 华佗（核心）
司马迁（对照：《史记》以文字自存于宫刑之辱——文火著述与焚书绝笔的两种知识命运）
李时珍（传承：以《本草纲目》的巨型文档对抗知识失传——'欲究其极，必证其书'）
图灵（跨文明平行：纸上思想可存续而人不可——文档化使知识脱离个体生命周期的最早自觉）
